criterion: which assistant-command intent the utterance expresses, that is what the user wants done

categories.name: Informational Query
categories.definition: Requests for facts, definitions, general knowledge, or answers to questions not related to personal user data.

categories.name: Personal Information Lookup
categories.definition: Requests to retrieve specific data regarding the user's own accounts, finances, history, or personal records.

categories.name: Device and App Control
categories.definition: Commands to change device settings, configure the assistant, or control hardware functions.

categories.name: Media Control
categories.definition: Commands to play, stop, skip, or manage music, videos, and other media content.

categories.name: Calendar and Task Management
categories.definition: Requests to create, view, modify, or cancel calendar events, reminders, and to-do lists.

categories.name: Communication
categories.definition: Requests to send messages, make phone calls, or share information with other people.

categories.name: Booking and Reservation
categories.definition: Requests to make, modify, or cancel reservations for travel, dining, or services.

categories.name: Banking and Card Services
categories.definition: Requests to perform specific banking operations, manage cards, or resolve account issues.

categories.name: Navigation and Location
categories.definition: Requests for directions, finding nearby places, or checking traffic and travel conditions.

categories.name: Automotive
categories.definition: Requests for information or assistance specifically related to car maintenance and operation.

categories.name: Shopping
categories.definition: Requests to purchase items or find specific products for sale.

categories.name: Timer and Alarm
categories.definition: Requests to set, manage, or use timers and alarms.

categories.name: Creative and Entertainment
categories.definition: Requests for jokes, games, random generation, or other entertainment content.

categories.name: Social and Personal
categories.definition: Utterances involving social pleasantries, questions about the assistant's identity, or personal opinions.

categories.name: System Utility
categories.definition: Commands to stop, cancel, repeat, or correct the assistant's current actions or processes.
